chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Al-Waleed ibn Sabih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

I entered upon him one day, so he threw to me some clothes and said: 'O Waleed, fold them upon their corners.' So I stood up in front of him. Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'May Allah have mercy on Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays.' So I thought that he was comparing my standing in front of him with the standing of Al-Mu'alla in front of him. Then he said: 'Ugh to the world! Ugh to the world! Indeed, the world is a house of affliction in which Allah makes His enemy overcome His friend, and indeed after it is a house that is not like this.' So I said: 'May I be your ransom, and where is that house?' He said: 'Here!' and he pointed with his hand to the ground.

key_terms.الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ خُنَيْسٍ: Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays, a companion of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean when he says 'Ugh to the world' and points to the ground?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) uses the humble posture of standing before him to evoke the memory of Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays, a prominent companion known for his steadfastness, thereby linking personal presence to historical martyrdom. He laments the world as a 'dwelling of trial' where God permits His enemies to dominate His friends, a concept deeply resonant in Shia theology regarding the occultation and the struggle of the faithful. By pointing to the earth, he identifies the grave or the immediate physical reality as the true abode preceding the eternal hereafter, emphasizing the transient nature of worldly power.

en.hubeali: H 14917 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al-Waleed Bin Sabeeh, who has narrated the following:

I came up to Abu Abdullahasws one day, so heasws presented to me a piece of cloth and said: ‘O Waleed, fold this upon its corners’. So I stood up in front of himasws. Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘May Allahazwj have Mercy on Moalla Bin Khunays’. So I though heasws is comparing my standing in front of himasws with the way in which Moalla Bin Khuays may have stood in front of himasws. Then he aswssaid: ‘Ugh to the world! Ugh to the world! But rather, the world is a place of afflictions in which Allahazwj has Made Hisazwj enemies to overcome Hisazwj friends, but after it is a house which is not like this’. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you, and where is that house?’ Heasws said: ‘Over there!’ – and heasws pointed by hisasws hand to the ground’.
en.sarwar: 470. Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Abdullah Bin Al-Salt, from Yunus, from the one whom he mention, from Abu Baseer who said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said: ‘O Abu Muhammad!

Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic has Angels who cut off the sins from the backs of our (a.s.) Shites just like the cutting by the wind of the leaves from the tree in the season of autumn and that is the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[40:7] hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe”, and Allah (azwj) has not Intended by this other than you’.
